name: Agent task
description: Runs one Claude Code task when the container starts: Claude works in the checkout and commits, and Codex (the codex-session feature) reviews what it committed. Pushing is blocked (except in linear mode, which opens a PR); the outcome is recorded in /tmp/agent-task/result.json.

prompt.description: The task. Empty does nothing, unless linear is set.

workspace.description: The checkout Claude works in. Empty is the workspace folder (where lifecycle commands run).

review.description: Have Codex review Claude's commits (needs the codex-session feature).

linear.description: Take the task from the Linear agent session named by the codespace's display name, push the commits as a PR, post the outcome to the session, and delete the codespace.
